subject: Important Update: Changes to Our Service Plans
body: Dear valued customers, We hope this email finds you well. We wanted to inform you about some upcoming changes to our service plans that will be effective starting next month. These changes are aimed at enhancing your overall experience with our products and services. We understand the importance of transparency, so we will be providing detailed information on how these changes may impact you personally. Please take the time to review the updated terms and feel free to reach out to our customer support team if you have any questions or concerns. Thank you for your continued support.
